description: Composite RAW-SCAN -> DATUM transform. Datum A = cup rim annular face -> XY plane at Z=0 with material in +Z (plane fit rms 0.052 mm over 30,342 raw faces). Datum B = rotation axis (cup bore + skirt + hex pocket common axis) -> +Z. Datum C = arm 1 centreline -> +X (theta=0); arms 2/3 fall at +120/-120 deg. Apply to the RAW scan; row-major 4x4, homogeneous, mm.
scale_correction_note: NONE APPLIED. RE_SPEC 2 envelope scale check could not be run (ENV-1/2/3 empty in MEASUREMENTS.md). The four available mid-size caliper dims sit 0.4-1.6% under the scan (ratios 0.984/0.996/0.991/0.989) - not uniform enough to justify a global scale. Absolute scale is UNVERIFIED; caliper values are used directly as CAD parameters, which absorbs the discrepancy locally.
